verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents an account-export endpoint in the Marketing API that can generate and download a full account export, which covers the core of exporting your data before leaving. The evidence never states which formats the export uses or exactly what data it includes. missing for 10: confirmation of open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), documented scope of 'all data' (campaigns, reports, templates, Transactional data), a UI or help-center export and offboarding guide, independent hands-on corroboration.
